draft_en.subject: Media converters under the ENET label - next to the transceivers and cable assemblies
draft_en.body:
Hi Gordon,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 16 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Transceivers, DAC and AOC are yours and we do not touch them. For the media converters carried under the ENET label alongside them, in your packaging from small lots, -40 to 75 C, FCC/CE/RoHS: industrial Gigabit converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); PoE version - STI-111GP - $30.1; and an 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged DIN switch - STI-280GE - $46.

One question: which converter configuration do your customers order most with a fibre link - SFP-slot or fixed-fibre?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
